components.name: Activity
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Intent extras are no longer automatically added to defaultViewModelCreationExtras for exported activities. Developers of exported activities can override defaultViewModelArgs to explicitly provide validated intent extras. (Id0cb6, b/213646066)
  • Activity now provides NavigationEventDispatcherOwner and OnBackPressedDispatcherOwner factory functions for creating the instances of the respective components easily. (I1d259, Iadd5c)
  • OnBackPressedDispatcher now provides an asNavigationEventDispatcher extension to easily covert it to a NavigationEventDispatcher. (Id11cf)

components.name: Appfunctions
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add @AppFunctionSignature as experimental public API. The API supports dynamic AppFunction registration via Jetpack. (I72e23, b/501032667)
  • Add AppFunctionState and AppFunctionManager#getAppFunctionStates. This replaces AppFunctionMetadata#isEnabled. The metadata is now completely separated from the state. (I8e490, b/494238383)
  • Add getAppFunctionActivityStates. (I41093, b/542075714)
  • Add ExtensionsAppFunctionService to support apps working with sidecar. (I7cf10, b/524941402)
  • Update observeAppFunctions API to match platform API. (Ifa6fb, b/494238381)

Bug Fixes

  • Fix the issue that missing runtime metadata could cause app to crash when calling setAppFunctionEnabled during OOBE. (Ibe229, b/536750020)
  • Temporary disable data validation when using AppFunctionData#serialize API until the metadata is coming from the same source of the truth. (I6c95, b/545200019)

components.name: Appsearch
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Make SearchSpec.Builder#addFilterDocumentIds and related methods non-experimental (I28986, b/540346408)
  • Additional refactoring to make AppSearch TakenAction classes extendable (Ibb625, b/521419188)
  • Observer callbacks added to ReadOnlyGlobalSearchSession which adds the API to EnterpriseGlobalSearchSession in preparation for support in future SDKs (I0db22, b/454623046, b/422241546)
  • Refactors AppSearch TakenAction and Built-in types to be extendable outside of Jetpack (Icfa9b, b/372929164)
  • Added APIs to support direct loading of int8 quantized embeddings in EmbeddingVector. (I0be71, b/390450012)
  • Introduce ANN APIs for embedding search (I86e6b, b/448886757)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixes a bug where setSchema with migrators ignored the forceOverride parameter (Id3c4f, b/384981085)

components.name: Camera
components.detailsHtml:

  • Fixed a compilation crash on newer JDK versions when resolving transitively imported JSpecify type annotations on CameraX internal fields. (I00bb4, b/543937345)

components.name: Compose Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Promoted Grid layout APIs (Grid, GridScope, GridConfigurationScope, GridFlow, Fr, GridTrackSize, GridTrackSpec, Modifier.gridItem) to stable. (I43ac4, b/462550392)
  • Added new semantics property BackgroundColor for Modifier.background (I7eec3, b/518049030)
  • Removed ExperimentalFlexBoxApi annotation and renamed pixel-based properties in FlexConfigScope with a Px suffix for clarity. (I5b24e, b/543092286)
  • Only keep around cached items when not in a lookahead pass. Introduced flag isKeepAroundDuringLookaheadDisabled. To return to the old behaviour set the flag to false. (I110e9)
  • Added isLazyLayoutItemAnimatorVisibleBoundsFixEnabled compose flag. When enabled, visible item index bounds are calculated before placement animations run in LazyList and LazyGrid measure. (I56150)
  • Fix consumption on initial pass in Draggable. This ensures that if a down event is consumed on initial pass, dragging starts immediately in the main pass. This behavior change is gated behind the feature flag ComposeFoundationFlags.isDraggableInitialPassConsumptionFixEnabled. (I6a77f, b/532946466)

components.name: Compose Material3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Renamed RichTimePickerDialog to VibrantTimePickerDialog, renamed richColors to vibrantColors in TimePickerDefaults and TimeInputDefaults, renamed richContainerColor and richShape to vibrantContainerColor and vibrantShape in TimePickerDialogDefaults, and renamed unselected color properties to periodSelectorContainerColor, periodSelectorContentColor, timeSelectorContainerColor, timeSelectorContentColor, and clockDialContentColor. (Iea5aa)
  • Update the Rich TimePicker API to allow for an uncontained scroll/input dialog. (I2b3b6)
  • Introduced SelectableDropdownMenuItem and CheckableDropdownMenuItem for selectable and checkable expressive menu items. Updated DropdownMenuItem with shape to use MenuItemColors, and added MenuDefaults.itemVibrantColors() to support vibrant MenuItemColors. (I160ca)
  • Added opinionated expressive ToggleButton, ElevatedToggleButton, FilledTonalToggleButton, and OutlinedToggleButton overloads with ButtonSize and icon slot. Simplified ToggleButtonDefaults, ElevatedToggleButtonDefaults, FilledTonalToggleButtonDefaults, and OutlinedToggleButtonDefaults method names to colors() and border(). (Iab484)
  • Removed deprecated overloads of pinnedScrollBehavior and enterAlwaysScrollBehavior from TopAppBarDefaults. Use the overloads that take ScrollableState instead. (Idef9d)
  • Removed deprecated experimental API LocalMotionScheme from MaterialTheme. Use MaterialTheme.motionScheme instead. (I4b61d)
  • Added TimeInputDefaults and TimeInputColors for TimeInput. (I7534e)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where ScrollDisplayModeToggle announced 'Switch to scroll mode' while in scroll mode. (I2d588)
  • Fixed an issue where DropdownMenuItem without a leading icon did not align trailing icons to the end of the menu item. (Ia24ff, b/542873381)

  • Remove Component Override APIs for ThreePaneScaffold (I9ceb5)

components.name: Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • RemoteAbsoluteAlignment is now public and accessible outside of the library group. (Id9ceb)
  • Added fontFeatureSettings and fontVariationSettings support in RemoteTextStyle, RemoteText, and RemoteTimeText. (I6e78d, b/544644370)
  • Added support for fontVariationSettings in RemoteTextStyle. (I2c44a, b/542047368)
  • RemoteCollapsibleColumn and RemoteCollapsibleRow are now public and accessible outside of the library group. (I5ec72)

Bug Fixes

components.name: Compose Remote Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
The initial release of the androidx.compose.remote.foundation library. The Remote Foundation library is designed to contain design system agnostic UI Components for Remote Compose.

androidx.compose.remote.foundation:foundation:1.0.0-alpha01 is released. Version 1.0.0-alpha01 contains these commits.

API Changes

  • Migrated basic Remote Compose widgets (RemoteBasicText, RemoteBasicImage, RemoteSpacer, RemoteBasicIcon) to the new remote-foundation library. (I259b2, b/532028292)

components.name: Compose Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added withLocalRetainedValuesStore, which lets you return values from the content lambda. (I8e871, b/542168593)
  • Added nullable overloads of rememberSerializable for MutableState. (I77b83, b/543285462)

components.name: Compose Ui
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added new semantics property BackgroundColor for Modifier.background (I7eec3, b/518049030)
  • You can now create Vertices from existing primitive arrays. (Ifaba8, b/496412761)
  • VectorPainter will now share internal graphics resources (ImageBitmap) when rendering the same ImageVector across multiple composables. This reduces redundant texture uploads and memory usage, improving performance in scenarios like lists using repeated icons. This optimization can be disabled via ComposeUiFlags.isVectorDrawCacheSharingEnabled. (I35639, b/331283180)
  • Add requestFocusForChildInLocalBounds helper (Ib1a48)

components.name: Core
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add disablePipOnAppSwitch to ContentPipExt (Ie5bad, b/542307174)
  • Introduced a fallback PiP solution in androidx.core.pip to maintain Picture-in-Picture functionality during navigation gestures (like quick switch) where native PiP may be suppressed. (If289a, b/540480397)

Bug Fixes

  • Callback onFinishContentPip if enterPip fails (I04b77, b/540480397)

components.name: Core
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Bump core-telecom to 1.1.0-beta01. (I5b514, b/529775455)
  • Fixed an issue where CallsManager#addCall could delay CallControlScope entry by up to 2 seconds while waiting for starting audio endpoint resolution and Bluetooth stabilization. (Ia1e89, b/540450085)
  • Fixed a race condition where invoking CallsManager#addCall or CallsManager#addCallWithExtensions while another call setup is in progress could lead to deadlocks or silent failures in the OS TransactionManager. Overlapping call setups are now immediately rejected with CallException(ERROR_CALL_NOT_PERMITTED_AT_PRESENT_TIME). (If0ac8, b/491156745)

components.name: Emoji2
components.detailsHtml:
** Performance Release **

This release is a major performance improvement over prior relases.

• Reduced memory footprint: Metadata trie RAM usage is reduced from ~2.2 MB to ~80 KB.
• Reduced startup overhead: Startup object allocations are reduced from 24,178 to 82.
• Allocation-free text scanning: Scanning standard Latin text now performs zero allocations.
• Reduced latency: Median Latin text scan latency is reduced by up to 83% (from 16.43 µs to 2.66 µs).
• Automatic bypass on API 35+: EmojiCompat processing is automatically bypassed on devices with system-updatable fonts.

API Changes

  • Added setUseAfterUpdatableSystemFonts to EmojiCompat.Config to optionally continue using EmojiCompat on Android 15 (API 35) and above even when updatable system fonts are available on all devices. The default value will disable EmojiCompat on API35+ saving memory and text processing latency. (I7235e, b/541363642)

Bug Fixes

  • Emoji2 picker - Updated Compose compileSdk to API 37. This means that a minimum AGP version of 9.2.0 is required when using Compose. (Id45cd, b/413674743)

components.name: Navigation
components.detailsHtml:
Important changes since 2.9.0:

  • NavHost now provides an overload that accepts predictivePopEnterTransition and predictivePopExitTransition parameters to allow for custom transition during the predictive back gesture.
  • handleDeepLink was modified to ensure only recognized deep links are handled while all others will be ignored. If this causes an error in your app, consider the possibility of swapping over to navigating via deep links defined in your navigation graph. For Robolectric tests you may need to use the setPackage method to a trusted packaged.
  • NavBackStackEntryInfo was added to expose back stack snapshots during navigation events. This enables richer custom predictive back animations.

Additional Platform Support

  • The navigation-common, navigation-runtime, and navigation-testing modules added support for desktop, linux, macOS, iOS, javascript, WASM, watchos, and tvos.

components.name: Navigation3
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where predictive back gestures that are triggered during a forward transition does not animate in response to swipe progress. The predictive back will now animate and complete properly. (Icdcb0, b/456218398)

components.name: Navigation3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Refactored DeepLinkRequest.extras from Map<String, Any> to a new type safe map-like class RequestExtras which stores pairs of RequestExtrasKey<T> to T. RequestExtras can be instantiated with the requestExtras DSL. (Ic929d, b/543883369)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where predictive back gestures that are triggered during a forward transition does not animate in response to swipe progress. The predictive back will now animate and complete properly. (Icdcb0, b/456218398)
  • Added a lint check for ensuring Scene implementations are either data classes, or implement equals and hashcode to ensure that the same Scene is used when appropriate. (Ibdf0d, b/542316099)
  • NavEntry.contentKey now defaults to a composite of key.toString() and key::class.toString(). This ensures that data objects that share the same name but implement different interfaces will no longer have the same contentKey. However, JS platform's key::class only returns simple class name instead of fully qualified name, so JS platform should still implement custom contentKey for data objects with duplicate names. (I1fbbb, b/512534342)
  • Fixed IllegalArgumentException thrown by SaveableStateProvider for duplicate keys used during rapid back navigation when multiple pop transitions are in-flight. (I4d728, b/516312097)

components.name: Pdf
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Promoted public APIs across all PDF artifacts to Beta, except those annotated with @ExperimentalPdfApi (Ia585f)

  • Added @ExperimentalPdfApi (a @RequiresOptIn annotation) to new APIs: PdfViewer, PdfViewerState, EditablePdfViewerFragment, AnnotationsView, and OcrProvider. (I83a93), (I34fe6)

  • Renamed onCreateOcrProvider to onInitOcrProvider to ensure single-time initialization per fragment instance.(Ice5d4)

  • Exposed OcrProvider to enable searching and selecting text in images or scanned PDFs, and provided a default implementation (MlKitOcrProvider) in the pdf-ocr-play-services artifact. (I6eaf4)

  • Updated pdfPointToVisibleOffset to be non-nullable, returning an offset or Offset.Unspecified if the PDF content has not yet been laid out. (If499a)

Enhancement and Bug Fixes

  • Optimized document searching in PdfViewerFragment by streaming page-by-page results and debouncing text input, creating a lag-free typing and navigation experience.

  • Fixed background crashes during large text selections in PdfView, by serializing lightweight boundary anchors, creating a stable state restoration experience.

  • Remove Translation Key collision for action search (I0cc35)

components.name: Room3
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Room suspending queries and invalidation tracker operations will now throw an IllegalStateException when called after the database has been closed. (I5755a, b/543076356)
  • Fix a deadlock that can occur on @Transaction DAO wrapper suspend functions that would do a context switch and had the AndroidSQLiteDriver configured. (886ac5, b/543285472)

components.name: Savedstate
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added public constructors to SavedStateRegistry and made SavedStateRegistry implement SavedStateProvider and SavedStateRestorer. (I3c696)
  • Added top-level SavedStateProvider interface. (I20f9d)
  • Added top-level SavedStateRestorer interface with restoreState(savedState: SavedState?) and removed unreleased SavedStateRegistry.SavedStateConsumer. (Idc01d)
  • AutoRecreated and runOnNextRecreation are deprecated in favor of SavedStateProvider and SavedStateRestorer. (Iadc00)
  • Introduce SavedStateConsumer interface on SavedStateRegistry. Allows registered providers to automatically receive and consume restored state during restoration, or immediately upon registration if state is already restored. (I9a378)
